# SearchField

A search box with a search icon, a clear button, a live result count ("42 of 1,284 tracks"), a typo-tolerant "Did you mean Overmono?" line and the "/" shortcut.

`SongNodes.SearchField` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.SearchField value="…" onChange={…} label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.SearchField" value="…" on-change="{{…}}" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (SearchFieldProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `string` | Current query. |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void` | Called on every change (debounce outside for large lists). |
| `label` * | `string` | Visually hidden label ("Search tracks"). |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Placeholder naming what can be searched. |
| `resultCount` | `{ shown: number; total: number; noun?: string }` | Matching count and total, rendered "42 of 1,284 tracks". |
| `suggestion` | `string` | Typo-tolerant suggestion shown when there are no results ("Overmono"). |
| `onSuggestion` | `(s: string) => void` | Called when the suggestion is chosen. |
| `shortcut` | `boolean` | Register the "/" shortcut and show its hint; default false. |
